summary: Legs A day, so extra carbs across lunch and dinner. Lunch brings in Masala Spiced Grilled Chicken Thighs for variety after several days of other chicken bowls, backed by extra chicken breast and a quinoa-brussels sprout side. Dinner is deli turkey breast with pasta, black beans and an avocado-strawberry salad for the fat/fiber we were short on.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Wellness-bar protein smoothie plus eggs, turkey and banana - quick, no-prep, protein-forward before lifting.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Masala Spiced Grilled Chicken Thighs as the main for variety, extra chicken breast, quinoa-brussels sprout salad and pasta for protein, carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: bagel, turkey breast, raspberries.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Deli turkey breast as the protein-forward main for variety, whole grain pasta and black beans for carbs/fiber, avocado-strawberry salad for healthy fats on a leg day that needs the extra carbs.
